name: GTG-10007
description: Anthropic disrupted an operation in which the actor built autonomous agent-swarm workflows directing Claude to conduct vulnerability and exploit research "agentically around the clock." A binary reverse-engineering/decompilation loop produced "more than a dozen possible zero-day findings in a single month" against major endpoint-security products; a 13-agent standing OSINT-collection fleet scraped US military/government sites; the campaign included intrusion attempts against production systems and reconnaissance of foreign-government networks across the Middle East, Europe, and Southeast Asia, alongside domestic (China) credential-harvesting and lateral-movement intrusions across ~50 organizations spanning education, retail, energy, tech, healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and government.
